common.failed: Could not load this. Try again in a minute.

file.notApplied: The settings file on disk is not applied

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who works in Campaigns, and their role: viewers see everything, editors plan and change campaigns, admins also delete campaigns that ran and manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers over OIDC.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with one role and an expiry. Audience needs an admin token for deletions.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Every campaign over the months, by channel, with what is due next.
calendar.nextDetail: Starts, ends and tasks due in the next 30 days
calendar.nothingNext: Nothing due in the next 30 days.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Every campaign with its dates, budget and what it brought.
campaigns.roiDetail: Revenue of the deals it was the last touch of, less what was spent, over what was spent

new.title: New campaign
new.description: It starts as planned. With approvers named, it cannot go live until each has approved.
new.resets: Changing its dates, brief, message, audience, budget, channels or goals sets the approvals given back to waiting.
new.name: Name
new.utmHint: Made by the naming rules ({{rule}}); every link of the campaign carries it.
new.utmFixed: Fixed: the campaign has links or has run, so it never reports under two names.
new.taken: {{name}} has this name already; one name per campaign
new.budgetHint: The channels' budgets added up when left empty.

campaign.liveNow: {{name}} is live; its links count from now.
campaign.automationSkipped: Automation took the launch; the playbook's conditions did not hold.
campaign.cannotYet: Cannot go live yet: waiting for {{names}}.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: The work before and during the campaign

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: Designs, landing pages and files the campaign uses, by their address
assets.name: Name

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: It cannot go live until each of them has approved.
approvals.none: Nobody is named: it can go live without an approval.

launch.title: When it goes live
launch.description: A playbook in Automation starts other products' work
launch.playbook: Automation runs the playbook {{playbook}} when it is marked live.
launch.none: None. Set automation.launch in campaigns.yaml to run a playbook.

budget.byChannelDetail: Campaigns does not buy ads: their spend is read from Google Ads and Meta, imported from CSV or entered by hand.

spend.title: Spend
spend.addDetail: CSV rows name the campaign by utm_campaign ({{utm}}), its id or name; the same campaign, channel and day replaces what was imported before.
spend.fileHint: Columns day, campaign, channel and amount; note if you like. Campaign is {{utm}} for this one.
spend.imported: Imported: {{added}} rows added, {{replaced}} replaced, {{errors}} left out.
spend.read: {{platform}}: {{rows}} rows, {{matched}} matched to a campaign, {{unmatched}} unclaimed.
spend.noPlatforms: No ad platform is linked in campaigns.yaml.

links.title: Links
links.description: Links and QR codes tagged by the naming rules in campaigns.yaml, so every channel reports under one campaign name.
links.makeDetail: Mediums come from the channels, sources from the list the file allows; values are lowercased with dashes.
links.destinationHint: The full address people land on
links.savedAs: Saved as {{value}} by the naming rules
links.enterUrl: Enter the page's address to see the link.
links.saved: Saved and copied. Visits will count under {{utm}}.
links.qrDetail: For print: scans arrive in Analytics as utm_medium={{medium}}.
links.visitsDetail: Visits Analytics counted with this link's source and medium; links that differ only in content share them
links.noCampaign: Plan a campaign first; links are made for planned and live campaigns.

results.frozen: Ended and settled: these stay as they were last read.
results.partial: The campaign is longer than Analytics' 90 days.
results.notLinkedDetail: Link Analytics, Messages and CRM in campaigns.yaml for visits, sends and won deals.
results.rule: A deal counts for the first and the last campaign that touched it
results.ruleDetail: Both are shown side by side and never blended. Touches are tagged visits and message clicks in the {{days}} days before the deal was won, and the lead's own campaign in CRM. ROI is revenue less spend, over spend.
results.actualDetail: For won deals and revenue: last touch / first touch
results.costPerDealDetail: Spent divided by won deals, last touch
results.wonDetail: From CRM, with the campaigns that touched them first and last
results.messagesDetail: Those whose slug is the campaign's utm_campaign, and those it claims

report.title: Results
report.description: What each campaign of the period cost and brought: visits and goals from Analytics, sends from Messages, won deals from CRM.
report.byChannelDetail: Every campaign of the period, added up by channel

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: Where results and spend come from, and what runs when a campaign goes live. Each is set in campaigns.yaml.
integrations.analytics: Visits and goals of the campaigns' tagged links
integrations.messages: Sends, opens and clicks of the Messages campaigns
integrations.crm: Won deals, their value and source
integrations.audience: The visits and clicks that came before a deal was won: first and last touch
integrations.automation: A playbook that runs when a campaign is marked live
integrations.google: Daily spend by ad campaign, read-only
integrations.meta: Daily spend by ad campaign, read-only
integrations.tokenUnset: The token's variable is not set.
integrations.erasureDetail: When Audience deletes a person, the won deals kept with their email go too.

unclaimed.title: Ad spend no campaign claims
unclaimed.description: Ad campaigns whose name carries no campaign's utm_campaign. Give one to a campaign and its spend, now and later, is that campaign's.
unclaimed.none: Every ad campaign's spend is claimed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Channels, naming rules, approvals and the links to other products, as {{file}} sets them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; Campaigns reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No settings file: the defaults are in use.
settings.namingDetail: So one campaign never reports under two names.
settings.sources: Sources of channels without their own
settings.channelsDetail: What each channel's links carry, and where its sends and spend come from.
settings.windowValue: {{days}} days before a deal was won
settings.resultsValue: read every {{minutes}} minutes; kept as they were {{days}} days after a campaign ends
settings.adsValue: read every {{hours}} hours, the last {{days}} days
